# The Basement Guide

> Independent, expert-reviewed advice on basement waterproofing, sump pumps, finishing, insulation, and radon for homeowners.

The Basement Guide is an independent home-services publication covering basement waterproofing, foundation repair, sump pumps, moisture control, radon mitigation, egress windows, insulation, and basement finishing. Content is written for homeowners making real decisions about repairs, renovations, and contractor hiring. Every cost guide is updated for 2026 with regional pricing, and every product review is based on hands-on evaluation against manufacturer specs. Calculators return real repair and installation cost estimates. Homeowners can also request free quotes from vetted local contractors through partner Networx.

## Start Here

- [Start Here](https://thebasement.guide/start-here): Not sure where to start? Answer a few quick questions and get directed to the right basement guides for your situation.
